body:
The month grid retains every native chunk and complete popup while using measured native shapes and lightweight hidden markers. Actual geometry is reread per pass; current versions, ordinary source reads, page bounds and native gestures remain. No API, authorization, command or durability rule changes.

Quiet release M4 measurements for 1000 source cards improve shorter-plan/timed local cold readiness from 199–204 to about 110 ms, and whole-month plans from 737 to 252 ms. Constrained whole-month cold improves from 3.23 to 1.48 seconds. Small-fixture medians are unchanged. All 427 checks and release Chromium/WebKit Calendar workflows pass, including independent natural-height checks at large text and narrow widths.

Application revision 4906f1c is rebuilt and running at the existing HTTPS origin. All 60 prior resource versions, two pins, preferences and certificate are preserved; all 33 served frontend assets are verified. Broader performance remains open, including occasional duplicate Calendar reads, outliers, other distributions/concurrency/writes and physical-device limits. Evidence: progress/2026-10-01-calendar-measured-rendering.md.

metadata.summary: Measured native month shapes reduce dense Calendar readiness
